message.content:
This portrait-oriented editorial illustration features a grey background with a red vertical stripe on the left. The large black word “TEMPO” is centered at the top, above the smaller text “ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU”. Further up, white text reads “UANG SEMIR BEKAS BOS PETRAL” and “PUISI DAN JURNALISME AMARZAN LOEBIS”.

The central figure is a painted illustration of a man with light brown skin, dark hair parted to the side, and a white collared shirt. He is shown from the chest up in a three-quarter profile facing left. His eyes are closed and his lips are slightly pursed. Directly behind him, a dark grey shadow is cast onto the background. The shadow’s profile matches the man's head and neck, but it features an elongated, pointed nose extending horizontally to the left.

On the left side, white block text reads “JANJI TINGGAL JANJI” above a smaller paragraph starting with “PARA PEGIAT ANTIKORUPSI”. In the bottom right, small black text includes “16-22 SEPTEMBER 2019”, “RP 45.000”, and a barcode with the number “00030”.
